name: Demo learner (ML student)

topics.name: Scaled dot-product attention & softmax
topics.why: The core operation of the paper: queries, keys and values combined with a scaled dot product and softmax.

topics.name: Transformer architecture
topics.why: The model the paper proposes: encoder-decoder stacks of attention and feed-forward layers.

topics.name: Complexity & scaling constraints
topics.why: Attention cost grows quadratically with sequence length, which limits where the model applies.

topics.name: Sequence-to-sequence encoder-decoder framework
topics.why: The established framework this paper reworks; the demo learner already knows it well.
topics.search_query: sequence to sequence encoder decoder explained

topics.name: Recurrent networks (LSTM/GRU)
topics.why: The previous state of the art the Transformer replaces; the demo learner's strongest area.

topics.name: Embeddings & representation learning
topics.why: Tokens enter the model as learned vectors; input and output embeddings are tied in this paper.

topics.name: Linear algebra (matrices & vectors)
topics.why: Attention is matrix multiplication throughout: QK^T, projections and feed-forward layers.

topics.name: Probability & distributions
topics.why: Softmax turns attention scores into probability distributions over positions.

topics.name: Mathematical notation & equations
topics.why: Symbols like d_k, W^Q and multi-head concatenation carry the method's definition.
topics.search_query: multi head attention notation d_k explained

topics.name: Main results & headline findings
topics.why: BLEU gains on translation with far less training time than recurrent or convolutional models.
topics.search_query: attention is all you need results BLEU

topics.name: Assumptions the method makes
topics.why: Attention assumes any position can attend to any other, so order must be injected explicitly.
topics.search_query: positional encoding why transformers need it

topics.name: Baselines & ablation studies
topics.why: Comparisons and ablations show which components (heads, d_k, dropout) actually matter.

topics.name: Convolutional neural networks
topics.why: A competing sequence-modelling approach the paper compares against on cost and path length.

topics.name: Data & compute constraints
topics.why: Training used large corpora and multiple GPUs; results assume that scale of data and compute.

topics.name: Evaluation metrics: accuracy, precision, BLEU, perplexity
topics.why: BLEU and perplexity are how the paper scores translation quality and language modelling.

topics.name: Interpreting the results
topics.why: Reading the tables: which gains come from the architecture versus training setup.
topics.search_query: how to read machine translation results tables

topics.name: Normalization layers
topics.why: Residual connections and layer normalization wrap every sub-layer in the Transformer.

topics.name: Optimization theory
topics.why: Adam with warmup and decay schedules is how the model is actually trained.
topics.search_query: Adam optimizer learning rate warmup explained

goal: understand the Transformer well enough to explain it to classmates
